efile.text: Withholding deposit reports and the annual withholding reconciliation must be submitted electronically unless you've been granted a department waiver from electronic filing.

returns.name: Form WT-6, Withholding Deposit Report
contents: Filed and paid for every reporting period of the assigned frequency, electronically (My Tax Account, telefile, e-file transmission or ACH credit), even if nothing was withheld; annual filers file none.
ACH debit payments through My Tax Account must be initiated by central standard time of the due date.

returns.name: Form WT-7, Annual Reconciliation of Wisconsin Income Tax Withheld
contents: All filers with an active withholding account file it, with W-2s and information returns, by January 31; within 30 days of the cease date when the account closes early.
Employers filing quarterly, monthly or semi-monthly cannot submit it until every WT-6 has been filed; it is rejected if its total exceeds the WT-6 total or a deposit is missing.

deposits.interpretation: Wisconsin assigns each employer an ANNUAL, QUARTERLY, MONTHLY or SEMI-MONTHLY filing frequency; the guide does not give the thresholds, so the frequency is an INPUT and is never derived. Liability is incurred when wages are PAID, not earned. Deposit report (Form WT-6) due dates: QUARTERLY and MONTHLY: the last day of the month following the period. SEMI-MONTHLY: wages paid from the 1st to the 15th are reported for the period ending the 15th and are due the LAST DAY of that month; wages paid from the 16th to month end are reported for the period ending the last day and are due the 15th of the following month (the guide's example: paid December 16, due January 15). ANNUAL filers file no deposit report: withholding is reported and paid with the annual reconciliation (Form WT-7) due January 31, which this profile uses as the annual payment date. A deposit report is filed for every period, even with no tax. A due date on a weekend or holiday moves to the next business day. The department may grant a one-month extension for good cause (not modelled).

returns.name: Quarterly contribution report (UCT-101) and wage report
contents: Due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday under state or federal law moves it to the next day that is not one (DWD 110.07(4)).
DWD will stop mailing Quarterly Tax Reports in 2027; employers should file electronically (DWD File Tax Report page).
